snippet.title: DOSMIC - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
In a world consumed by darkness,
a young boy begins his journey to reclaim the girl,
facing unknown and monstrous beings along the way.

This video showcases gameplay from Chapter 1 of DOSMIC.
Please note that some visuals and elements may change as development progresses.

DOSMIC is currently being developed solo,
and I look forward to sharing more updates filled with deeper emotions and immersive experiences.

▶️ Developed by: BlackCheeze
▶️ SoundTrack : Adagio - Thomas-Adam Habuda

▼ Stay updated on DOSMIC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450900/DOSMIC/
